newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish live register falls to 273,800 in Oct - CSO.
newsitem.headline: Irish live register falls to 273,800 in Oct - CSO.

text.p: Irish unemployment, as measured by the live register of those claiming unemployment benefits, fell to a seasonally adjusted 273,800 in October versus 281,400 in September, Central Statistics Office (CSO) figures showed on Friday.

The CSO said that following the preliminary results from the 1996 Labour Force Survey, it was revising its estimates for the percentage unemployment rate, and did not yet have an estimate for October.
It said the Standardised Unemployment Rate (SUR) series had been revised for the period May 1995 to April 1996. The SUR for April is now estimated at 11.9 percent, it said.
